messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a three‑day weekend; if they fall on a weekend, the following Monday is usually observed):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if needed) |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | — |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | — |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | — |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | — |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | — |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Wednesday) | — |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | — |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — |

If you’re looking at specific provinces or territories, some may have additional holidays (e.g., St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17). Let me know if you’d like province‑specific details!
message.reasoning: The user wants the list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a tool "connectBluetooth" but that's irrelevant. There's no tool to fetch holidays. We can provide the answer manually. We should respond with the list. The user didn't specify format. Provide a list of dates. Let's give them the list.
